scheme_name: Pension Scheme for State Agitators Other Than Category of Agitators Who Went to Jail for 7 Days or got Injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement
description:
The Pension Scheme for State Agitators Other Than Category of Agitators Who Went to Jail for 7 Days or got Injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement was launched by the Government of Uttarakhand.

This scheme was officially introduced on 1st January 2021.

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to individuals who participated in the Uttarakhand state movement but do not fall under the category of agitators who were imprisoned for over seven days or those who sustained injuries during the movement.

The scheme aims to recognize the contributions of these agitators towards the formation of the state and to ensure their financial security in their later years.

The government has set a target to provide pensions to approximately 5,000 eligible beneficiaries under this scheme.

Each eligible beneficiary will receive a monthly pension of ₹5,000.

This amount is intended to provide a basic level of financial support to the beneficiaries.

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are specifically defined.

Applicants must be residents of Uttarakhand.

They should have actively participated in the Uttarakhand state movement.

The age limit for applicants is set at a minimum of 60 years.

There are no specific educational qualifications required to apply for this pension scheme.

However, applicants must provide proof of their participation in the state movement.

This proof can include documents such as affidavits or certificates issued by recognized organizations involved in the movement.

The application process for this pension scheme is straightforward.

Interested individuals must obtain the application form from the official website of the Uttarakhand government or designated offices.

The completed application form must be submitted to the District Magistrate's office.

Applicants need to attach relevant documents that establish their eligibility.

These documents include proof of age and evidence of participation in the state movement.

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the concerned authorities.

The review process may take up to 30 days.

After approval, the pension will be disbursed monthly.

The pension amount will be directly credited to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Personnel, Government of Uttarakhand.

For any inquiries or assistance, beneficiaries can contact the Department of Personnel.

The contact number for the Department of Personnel is 0135-271-2000.

The scheme is part of the government's broader initiative to support the welfare of individuals who contributed to the state's formation.

The government has allocated a budget of ₹25 crores for this scheme in the financial year 2021-2022.

This budget is expected to cover the pensions for all eligible beneficiaries.

The scheme is expected to be reviewed annually to assess its impact and effectiveness.

The government aims to ensure that the benefits reach the intended recipients without any delays.

In addition to the monthly pension, the government may also consider providing additional benefits in the future.

These benefits could include healthcare support or assistance with housing.

The scheme is a significant step towards acknowledging the sacrifices made by the agitators during the Uttarakhand state movement.

It reflects the government's commitment to the welfare of its citizens.

The pension scheme is expected to enhance the quality of life for many elderly citizens in Uttarakhand.

As of October 2023, the scheme continues to operate effectively.

The government has received positive feedback from beneficiaries regarding the timely disbursement of pensions.

The scheme has also been promoted through various government channels to ensure awareness among potential beneficiaries.

Local government offices have been instructed to assist applicants in completing the application process.

The government is also working on improving the online application process for better accessibility.

This initiative is part of a larger trend of the government focusing on social security measures for vulnerable populations.

The pension scheme is a testament to the government's recognition of the historical significance of the Uttarakhand state movement.

It serves as a model for similar welfare schemes aimed at other groups of citizens who have contributed to social and political causes.

The government encourages eligible individuals to apply for the scheme to secure their financial future.

The pension amount is expected to be reviewed periodically to keep pace with inflation and rising living costs.

The government aims to ensure that the pension remains a viable source of income for the beneficiaries.

Overall, the Pension Scheme for State Agitators Other Than Category of Agitators Who Went to Jail for 7 Days or got Injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement is a crucial welfare initiative.

It not only provides financial assistance but also honors the legacy of those who fought for the creation of Uttarakhand.

The scheme is an essential part of the state's commitment to social justice and welfare.

It highlights the importance of recognizing and supporting the contributions of citizens to the democratic process.

The government remains dedicated to enhancing the lives of its citizens through various welfare initiatives.

This scheme is a clear indication of that commitment.
